notes.quote: Estimates are included in aggregate data, but the estimates are not included in the file of Company-Level Imports.
notes.consequence: Do not assume company-level totals equal aggregate national imports. Check whether the API crude-oil-imports aggregate contains estimates before calling it a whole national total; petroleum/move aggregate routes remain separate candidates.

notes.quote: Crude oil produced outside the U.S. and brought into the U.S.
notes.consequence: Import-cost partner names describe U.S. imports, not foreign-country price totals.

notes.quote: For purposes of this survey, the United States includes the 50 States, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, the Virgin Islands, and all American territories and possessions.
notes.consequence: Retain survey geography basis; do not silently equate all US series scope across sources.
